turns.agent:
Welcome to Marine Corps Base Quantico! I have set your installation to Quantico and can help you find information on MCCS programs, facilities, and services on base. 

Here are a few areas I can help you explore at MCB Quantico:
* **Recreation & Fitness:** Gyms and fitness programs (including HITT and personal training), Medal of Honor Golf Course, bowling, pools, Lunga Park, marinas, and the Auto Skills Center.
* **Marine & Family Programs:** Child and youth programs, the School Liaison Program, relocation/PCS support, deployment readiness, and education resources.
* **Shopping & Services:** Marine Corps Exchange (MCX), barber shops, post offices, and dining.
* **Temporary Lodging:** Inns of the Corps Quantico and Marine Lodge Quantico (Liversedge).

**Next Steps**
* Let me know what specific facility, program, or service you are looking for (such as gym hours, childcare, auto skills, or upcoming events), and I will get the exact details for you.

**Sources**
* [MCCS Quantico Recreation & Fitness](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/recreation/outdoor-recreation/golf-course)
* [Inns of the Corps Quantico](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/lodging/inns-of-the-corps)
* [MCCS Quantico School Liaison Program Brochure](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/modules/media/?do=download&id=b3f2cf54-e776-4da0-9c96-7ee4d28879b9&v=1)

The main fitness facility at MCB Quantico is the **Barber Physical Activity Center (BPAC)** on Main Side, along with the **High Intensity Tactical Training (HITT) Center** located right behind it.

**Barber Physical Activity Center (BPAC)**
* **Location:** Building 2073, Barnett Ave, Quantico, VA 22134 (parking is at BPAC, across the street at Barnett Field, and next to Butler Stadium).
* **Phone:** (703) 432-0590
* **Regular Hours:** Monday–Friday, 5:00 AM – 8:00 PM; Saturday, 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM; Sunday & Federal Holidays, Closed. *(Note: An older MCCS flyer lists weekend hours until 5:00 PM, so please call (703) 432-0590 to confirm weekend availability.)*
* **Unmanned Access:** Available 30 minutes after regular closing until 30 minutes before opening (and on federal holidays) for registered Active Duty Military, MCINCR-MCBQ PMO Civilians, and Fire Department personnel only.
* **Amenities:** 9,600 sq. ft. fitness deck, functional fitness room, group exercise and spin studios, basketball court, three racquetball courts, locker rooms, and saunas.
* **Eligibility & Fees:** 100% ID check required (except active duty in utility/service uniform). Base contractors may access BPAC for $5/day or $40/month. Monthly lockers are $15.

**HITT – High Intensity Tactical Training Center**
* **Location:** Building 3117, Quantico, VA 22134 (behind BPAC).
* **Phone:** (703) 784-5799 | **HITT Coordinator:** (703) 432-0592
* **Open Gym Hours:** Monday–Friday, 5:00 AM – 8:00 AM & 11:00 AM – 1:00 PM.
* **Instructor-Led Classes (Active Duty/Reservists only):** Monday–Friday, 11:30 AM – 12:30 PM.
* **Note:** Closed on federal holidays. Marines participating in HITT have priority over equipment and space.

**Next Steps**
* Bring your DoD ID to the BPAC front desk to check in or register for after-hours unmanned access.
* If you are looking for Personal Training, call (703) 432-0593, or for Group Exercise schedules, call (703) 784-2339.

**Sources**
* [MCCS Quantico – Barber Physical Activity Center](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/fitness)
* [MCCS Quantico – HITT Center](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/fitness/fitness-programs/high-intensity-tactical-training)
* [MCCS Quantico – Personal Training](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/fitness/fitness-programs/personal-training)

The Barber Physical Activity Center (BPAC) does not have a pool inside the facility. However, MCB Quantico has two separate aquatic facilities on base: the seasonal **Quantico 50M Pool** (operated by MCCS on Main Side) and the indoor **Ramer Hall Pool** (located on the west side at Camp Barrett/The Basic School).

**1. Quantico 50M Pool (MCCS – Seasonal Outdoor Pool)**
* **Status Notice:** This is a seasonal outdoor facility open from mid-May to the last Friday in September, so it is closed for the off-season.
* **Location:** Adjacent to The Clubs at Quantico (Main Side).
* **Phone / Weather Hotline:** (703) 784-2973
* **Email:** quantico.aquatics@usmc-mccs.org
* **Amenities:** 50-meter pool, 1- and 3-meter diving boards, a zero-entry wading pool with a slide and water feature, and locker rooms with showers.
* **In-Season Operations:** Depending on seasonal staffing and time of summer, weekday hours (Monday–Friday, 5:30 AM – 1:00 PM) are for Active Duty PT/lap swim and military training, with recreational swim hours offered during peak summer months and weekends for DoD ID cardholders.

**2. Ramer Hall Pool (Indoor Pool – Camp Barrett / TBS)**
* **Location:** Ramer Hall, Camp Barrett (adjacent to The Basic School on the west side of MCB Quantico).
* **Phone:** (703) 432-6601
* **Eligibility:** Open to DoD ID cardholders (TBS Basic Officer Course training and military swim courses take priority).
* **Published Lap Swim Hours:** Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM – 7:30 AM and 11:00 AM – 12:30 PM.
* **Swim Qualification:** Open swim qualification (Water Survival Basic or Intermediate) is offered on Tuesdays at 7:30 AM for Marines.

**Next Steps**
* For year-round indoor lap swimming or swim qualification, call Ramer Hall Pool at **(703) 432-6601** before heading over to confirm a military swim course is not in session.
* For questions about MCCS aquatics or upcoming seasonal lifeguard courses, email **quantico.aquatics@usmc-mccs.org** or call **(703) 784-2973**.

**Sources**
* [MCCS Quantico – Quantico Pool](https://lejeunenewriver.usmc-mccs.org/programs/97b47f01-012e-4726-b136-0a72428f5ba3)
* [MCB Quantico – Ramer Hall Pool & Water Survival Training](https://www.quantico.marines.mil/News/News-Article-Display/Article/518337/ramer-hall-expands-swim-hours-beefs-up-remedial-training/)
* [MCB Quantico – Water Survival Training Program Schedule](https://www.quantico.marines.mil/News/Article/1197636/water-survival-training-can-save-your-life/)
